subject.title: [Bug]: Reused changed-gate checkout retains stale overlay state

question: Is the focused wrapper regression coverage sufficient, or must this remain open until a real reusable Testbox lease proves two successive revisions reconstruct cleanly?
rationale: The expected invariant is clear, but closure depends on whether maintainers accept source-level regression coverage or require remote same-lease behavior proof for the infrastructure path.

options.title: Require same-lease proof
options.body: Run two distinct changed-gate revisions through one reusable Testbox lease and confirm the second tree and generated baselines contain no state from the first run.

options.title: Accept focused coverage
options.body: Treat the existing wrapper regression coverage and checkout reconstruction logic as sufficient evidence, then close through explicit maintainer action.

recommendation.title: Require same-lease proof
recommendation.body: Run two distinct changed-gate revisions through one reusable Testbox lease and confirm the second tree and generated baselines contain no state from the first run.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the reproduction, expected checkout invariant, and referenced implementation boundary for this maintainer-infrastructure path.
